body:
## Result

Conditional **kappa = 0.001675224519162937**, improving the source-pinned [PR1148](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1148) value **0.001675121647789207** by **0.000000102871373730**, approximately **0.00614113 percent** relative.

The conservative endpoint gives **kappa = 0.001675224516317980**. The comparison is the frozen proposal snapshot through PR1153. This is a new finite conditional construction under the inherited interfaces; the selected certificate and upstream sources are unchanged. Only `research/crosscall-kernel-demotion/` is added.

## Construction: augment actual physical gaps across calls

PR1148 already incorporates three demotion groups, 603/611/619, eight rank-seven helper ends and its T16 hosting. Its final assignment leaves 360 rank-one pending remainders. This package builds three additional, concretely checked local prefixes, ordered **627, 635, 651**, and couples them to those actual gaps.

- Their helper indices are `(403,405,406,407)`, `(411,413,414,415)` and `(427,429,430,431)`.
- Lowering an entrance from dimension five to four changes each affected helper's borrowed width from four to five. Every group therefore needs four actual additional pending axes. Its complete local profile difference is `L = -8H1 + 8H2 + 4H3 - 4H4`.
- Group 651 uses a different codimension-one hyperplane from the earlier unsuccessful candidate. Each complete joint prefix is rebuilt and checked; compatibility is not inferred from four individual width changes.
- Within a call, a selected helper with its own unit gap stays in place. Otherwise it exchanges owners with a width-four donor whose owner has a real unclaimed axis. Across calls, both source windows must contain the exchanged times, and neither incoming use may collide with another use of that physical family.
- A whole group is installed atomically. Every successful augmentation retains the existing groups, consumes four distinct unit gaps and updates the global capacity and busy-family state. A failed attempt rolls back its rows and state. The final table rebuilds all chronological coordinate offsets.

The within-call construction installs **42 groups**. Cross-call augmentation installs **47 more**, yielding **89 extra groups across 52 of 144 calls**. Provider prefixes zero through three occur **92, 30, 7 and 15 times**. Each role remains literal and whole; no fractional helper or width-only histogram substitutes for a physical owner.

Each installed group removes four paid rank-one remainders. Its complete paid difference is therefore `-12H1 + 8H2 + 4H3 - 4H4`. The written proof establishes strict moment improvement for every `0 < b < 1`, while the final exact arithmetic certifies the achieved endpoint.

The checked construction uses **10,271 actual orthogonal 73-column chart types**, compared with 10,580, and 59,621 cross-replica helper roles. All **1,409 changed owner records** are supplied as complete before/after rows against the frozen public table.

Both retained exact rational engines certify the native and conservative complex endpoints; all **47 strict outer inequalities** pass. The pinned inherited bit supplier is retained and the complex side binds. The arithmetic is computed from this one realized word-and-owner composition; advertised gains from separate PRs are not added.

## Reproduce and validation

Python 3.10+ and its standard library, from the repository root, with a fresh output path outside the package:

```sh
python -I -B research/crosscall-kernel-demotion/verify.py --out ../crosscall-result
```

The delivered checks bind the source inventory and recompute:

- All three extra joint prefixes on **704 arbitrary input columns** in forward and inverse-transpose orientations, including dirty-helper restoration and low-end legality; native emission, **25 emitted corruption controls per provider**, changed phase geometry and the full affected phase checks with 10, 20 and 30 phase controls for prefixes one, two and three, respectively.
- All **69,120 literal roles**, all 144 calls, actual provider widths, current-source inactivity windows, physical families, chronological axis blocks and actual 73-column charts. The independent mixed checker rejects **13 targeted controls**, including incorrect helper dispatch, wrong variants and omitted actual dispatch changes.
- Every unclaimed axis and the complete paid remainder/profile bill. The finite invoice passes **all nine guards and four controls**; its actual prefix is 397 bits and its physical row coefficient is 16,469.
- Both exact moment engines, endpoint decisions and all 47 outer inequalities. Source and artifact identities remain bound throughout.

These are fresh checks of the changed kernels, dispatch, literal map, geometry, invoice and pricing. Unchanged ancestral construction/phase interfaces remain inherited. No full ancestral cold rebuild, hosted CI result, independent human review, new Lean certificate or global allocation optimum is claimed.

The all-size/compiler, common-label and mutable-source realization, complete-call hosting, precision/tape and exact-recovery, analytic-transfer and inherited bit H1-H5 assumptions remain conditional.

## Reusable proofs and mathematical sources

The package notes and source ledgers in `research/crosscall-kernel-demotion/README.md` record two distinct OpenAI-proof mechanisms investigated by each of the four workers, their exact statements and source hashes, and their concrete use or limitations. The owner lane uses a left-saturation-preserving matching augmentation and explicit disjoint physical-pool capacity templates. These are source-grounded adaptations; the fractional conclusions of the pool source are not promoted to an integral owner witness. The literal table and independent geometry checks provide that witness.

The sufficient replacement proof and uniform saving argument are supplied for reuse. The notes also retain the within-call fallback, the tested last-gap relocation attempt and the rejected T37 composition. A bounded attempt did not install the final possible four-unit group; the remaining four gap families have no common recipient in the current table. Longer rearrangements and changed inventories remain open. No global optimality follows from that finite attempt.

The naive T37 width adaptation was rejected by exact pricing and is not numerically composed into this T16 result. **PR1063/1094** informed neutral recolouring and owner augmentation, and **PR1072** supplies the related promotion-to-gap precedent. Source pins, original notices, author attribution, AI disclosures and Apache-2.0 licensing are retained.

The new construction, proofs, independent checks and packaging were prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No name or email of the submitting user is added. The assistant did not publish or push anything.

The final self-contained replay passed from the delivered exact source inventory. Optimized Python and a mutated source file were separately rejected before mathematical execution. The candidate plan retains only freshly checked geometry; actual per-call widths and profiles come from the explicit dispatch and fresh native contracts.
